defect_classification.summary: A locator configured on a matched query-expansion rule is not necessarily an active contribution in the final canonical RetrievalPlan.
defect_classification.mechanism: Production analyze() applies the generic policy: if the accepted intent is not algorithm_theory or algorithm_implementation, paper_page_hints are cleared (src/panda_agent/retrieval.py). The first prospective n014 plan therefore did not contain the selected-rule pflueger_2017 [51, 57, 65] page-hint contributions although model_factory_theory matched.
defect_classification.original_contract_gap: The original A4/A5 pre-outcome gate required the exact frozen candidate mask to be represented in every acquired plan and treated any absent configured component as protocol-invalid. That conflated configured mask components with active runtime contributions and made the experiment non-constructible for deterministic runtime-policy drops.
defect_classification.stop_was_correct: Under the original frozen contract the fail-closed STOP was the correct outcome; R1 repairs the contract for a future separately authorized continuation and does not reinterpret the historical verdict.

configured_vs_active_distinction.configured_retirement_candidate_mask: Frozen D4-A4 masks remain the historical configured retirement candidates; R1 never rewrites them.
configured_vs_active_distinction.runtime_component_applicability: For every configured component of a matched selected Batch-2 rule, the prospective plan classifies the selected-rule contribution into exactly one of:

applicability_statuses.ACTIVE_IDENTIFIABLE: The selected Batch-2 rule contributed this exact component to the final canonical plan; selected-rule provenance is present and unambiguous; the contribution can be removed from the retirement execution projection while preserving independent origins. Scientifically testable in this plan.
applicability_statuses.INACTIVE_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: The configured component was not contributed by the selected Batch-2 rule to the final canonical plan after normal production plan construction; its absence is a deterministic consequence of normal runtime policy or normal plan formation; no selected-rule contribution exists to subtract. Not protocol-invalid, not dependency observed, not retirement validated. RETIREMENT EFFECT NOT IDENTIFIABLE FOR THIS COMPONENT IN THIS PLAN; component remains HOLD.
applicability_statuses.AMBIGUOUS_INVALID: The component appears but selected-rule ownership cannot be determined, provenance is contradictory/incomplete, the projection cannot establish selected-rule removal, or treatment construction would require guessing or global deletion. Protocol-invalid and fail-closed.

configured_vs_active_distinction.selected_rule_origin_semantics: Applicability is decided by selected-rule origin in the contribution ledger, never by raw token presence. A token present only through independent origins (another matched rule or the accepted Analyzer semantic delta) leaves the selected-rule configured component INACTIVE_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE while the token itself remains active and untouched.
configured_vs_active_distinction.absence_semantics: The canonical plan is the unmodified production analyze() output; absence of a configured component from that plan is by construction a deterministic consequence of normal production plan formation and is therefore INACTIVE_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE, not INVALID.

projection_semantics.CURRENT_COMPAT: Exact canonical plan with all normal production contributions.
projection_semantics.BATCH2_RETIREMENT: Same canonical plan; remove only selected-rule origins classified ACTIVE_IDENTIFIABLE; preserve independent origins; do nothing for INACTIVE_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE; STOP before retrieval for AMBIGUOUS_INVALID.
projection_semantics.canonical_plan_immutability: The canonical plan is never mutated; treatment exists only as an arm-specific execution projection.
projection_semantics.inactive_is_not_automatically_safe: Absence of a configured component from one prospective plan does not validate production retirement of that component. INACTIVE_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE never counts toward RETIREMENT_VALIDATED, the successful-retirement numerator, the dependency-removal numerator, or production retirement eligibility; it remains HOLD unless a later prospective case naturally activates it or a separately governed lifecycle resolves it.

persistence_before_gate_requirement.defect: The first attempt consumed an n014 Analyzer call but lost its token accounting and full plan because the applicability gate terminated execution before durable persistence.
persistence_before_gate_requirement.repair: For every future Analyzer attempt the executor durably persists provider/canonical-plan data BEFORE any applicability gate can terminate execution: case ID, attempt index, provider call consumed, provider attempt count, token usage, model/location/temperature, canonical RetrievalPlan serialization, deterministic signature, matched rules, full ordered contribution ledger, provenance origin receipts, component applicability receipts, CURRENT_COMPAT projection, BATCH2_RETIREMENT projection (when constructible), and gate outcome.
persistence_before_gate_requirement.ambiguous_stops_retain_evidence: Even a plan later rejected as AMBIGUOUS_INVALID retains its accounting and diagnostic evidence.
persistence_before_gate_requirement.implementation_style: Existing A5 manifest/raw-artifact pattern; no database-backed scheduler, workflow engine, general resume framework, or transaction framework.
